title: Decode XORed Array
summary: Given an encoded array of length n-1 where each element is the result of XORing consecutive elements from the original array of length n, and the first element of the original array, decode the original array.
statement: Given an encoded array of length n-1 where each element is the result of XORing consecutive elements from the original array of length n, and the first element of the original array, decode the original array.
constraints: Given the first original value, reconstruct the full array.
hints: XOR is its own inverse: if a XOR b=e, then b=a XOR e.
Start with first and process encoded from left to right.
Append answer[-1] XOR encoded[i] for every encoded value.
Induction shows each append reconstructs the unique next original value.
editorial: Induction shows each append reconstructs the unique next original value.

tests.explanation: Starting at four and undoing each adjacent XOR yields [4,2,0,7,4].
